item.title: A&M cancels six courses to comply with policies restricting race, gender topics
item.description: COLLEGE STATION, Texas (FOX 44) - Texas A&M University has canceled six courses in order to comply with policies restricting race and gender topics. item.title: ICE detainee in North Texas denied visitors abruptly amidst facility safety concerns
item.description: Leqaa Kordia has been held in ICE Prairieland Detention Center in Alvarado, Texas for over 10 months due to an expired student visa, with concerns raised about the conditions inside the facility, including lack of heat, clothing, and proper nutrition.

item.title: Volunteers take part in the Point-In-Time Count
item.description: Volunteers and outreach workers spread out across Amarillo on Friday as part of the city's annual Point-In-Time Count, an effort aimed at better understanding homelessness through in-person surveys and direct interaction with people living without stable housing.
